# Local reference assets

Device frame images, optical rendering/shader logic, and DOM capture helpers are adapted from the public DuoSimulator frontend at https://duo.noctrue.com/simulator, retrieved 2026-11-11 for this user-requested local project. The application interface, local URL proxy, lifecycle scripts, and animation integration are maintained in this project.

Reference modules:
- https://duo.noctrue.com/assets/index-Zb57K8Xp.js
- https://duo.noctrue.com/assets/shaders-DXxyWGUu.js

`shaders.js` bundles Three.js r182 and retains its license banner.
